{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of 999,999.99 entries (internal test orders)
internal_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_orders)}")

# Check if there are any other forms of 999999.99 (without commas)
other_internal = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders without commas: {len(other_internal)}")

# Combine both types of internal test orders
all_internal = pd.concat([internal_orders, other_internal]).drop_duplicates()
print(f"Total internal test orders identified: {len(all_internal)}")"}
